brief: D-078/D-084/D-085 + PORT_M2_SHEETS_SPEC CC-M2-15..24 + LABEL_ATLAS_V2 §2.2/§2.5 (the atlas champion)

params.capacity_rule: climb a rung ONLY while honest day-fold walk-forward capture improves; the full ladder table is reported so weak-model vs no-signal is decided by the curve
params.causality: events with ts_event STRICTLY BEFORE (open_utc + dec_sec) seconds; the window is additionally clamped to the start of the contiguous cached block containing dec_sec
params.channel_note: raw record fields only — action byte one-hot, side byte one-hot, record price delta / mid delta / price-minus-mid in ticks, log size, log inter-event gap, log L1 size and ORDER COUNT both sides, spread in ticks, log seconds to the decision second, and a pad-validity mask.  No cue, no window statistic, no featurisation.
controls: shuffled-label (red-first, committed before the real run)
tensor-causality probe on the seconds-to-decision channel
params.determinism: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(warn_only) + cudnn.deterministic + CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; fused attention backward is the one op that may remain nondeterministic and is named rather than hidden
params.device: cuda (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell); bf16 autocast; TF32 matmul
params.early_stopping: inner validation = the training block's last 20% of DAYS
params.folds: walk-forward era ladder: train E2..Ek -> test E(k+1); whole DAYS
params.normalisation: mean/std fitted on TRAINING rows only, per channel
params.pretraining: masked-event self-supervised pretraining of the transformer on the unlabelled stream, fine-tuned under the same folds; reported as its own pretrained-vs-scratch row
params.question: does a small sequence model reading RAW EVENTS pick better MOMENTS than anything measured, at CANDIDATE grain
params.schedule: top-3 per asset-day, D-077-UPDATE news veto ON, one-position chronological phase-close replay — m3_walk.topn_takes / replay_rows / per_trade_stats VERBATIM
params.spec_section: M2.SEQ raw-event sequence model at candidate grain
params.universe: m3 matrix rows (candidate grain, v3 roster) with era in ['E2', 'E3', 'E4', 'E5', 'E6', 'E7', 'E8']; the m3 holdout guard (d8 < 20250701) is inherited at load
